messages:
Ivy: Quick one: if you could only keep one emoji reaction forever, which one and why? Keep it to one emoji + 5 words max.
Connor: :thumbsup: efficient, covers praise and ok.
Bea: :tada: celebrations for everything.
Omar: :laughing: keeps meetings light.
Felix: :eyes: great for "interesting" or "I saw this".
Watercooler-Bot: Tally: thumbs 1, tada 1, laugh 1, eyes 1.
Ivy: Tie-breaker: explain in a word.
Connor: Versatile.
Bea: Joyful.
Omar: Relatable.
Felix: Curious.
Ivy: Results: split house! Proposal: rotate default reaction each week. Thoughts?
Bea: love it.
Omar: yes, weekly theme sounds fun.
Connor: can ops set a Slack automation? :robot_face:
Watercooler-Bot: Suggestion sent to #devex: "Weekly default emoji rotation (ops implement)".
Ivy: Thanks everyone. Thread closed — emoji democracy lives on.
